title: observability: token-level cost/latency + tracing/logging dashboard + alert tuning
author: Arjun Patel
description: Add token-level cost and latency breakdowns to observability stack, wire detailed traces through the runtime, extend KV-cache metrics and reduce alert noise by tuning thresholds. Motivation: customers observed unexpected cost spikes caused by long-tail token emissions and cache-miss amplification; existing dashboards surface per-request latency but not per-token cost contributions which makes regressions hard to root-cause. This PR introduces: 1) new Prometheus metrics (redwood_token_cost_total, redwood_token_latency_bucketed, redwood_kv_cache_hit_ratio_by_model) emitted from the serving runtime with cardinality controls; 2) OpenTelemetry spans for per-token generation paths so traces show token batching, KV cache hits/misses and kernel selection; 3) a Grafana dashboard (observability/grafana/token_cost_latency_dashboard.json) with panels for token-level P50/P95/P99 latency, token cost by model/route, KV cache hit heatmaps, and flamegraph links into distributed traces; 4) Prometheus alert rule refinements to reduce pager noise (ex: raise token-cost spike threshold to 2.5x baseline for production and add sustained_window=10m, introduce per-model dampening for noisy low-traffic models); 5) logging adjustments to sample at 1% for high-frequency routes and to include token_id and cache_status for sampled events. Implementation notes: metrics instrumentation is implemented in services/runtime/src/telemetry.rs and services/runtime/src/kv_cache.rs with explicit sanitization and low-cardinality tag derivation; tracing hooks added in services/runtime/src/generation_span.rs; dashboard JSON and alert rules live under observability/grafana/ and telemetry/prometheus_rules/; docs updated at docs/observability/token-metrics.md. Rollout plan: feature-flagged metrics are enabled on staging for 48h and then gradually rolled to canaries with 5% traffic before full enablement. Testing: unit tests for metric emission, integration test validating metric labels and alert firing in perf-canary harness, local Grafana import verified. Risk & mitigation: increased metric volume is mitigated by bucketing and tag normalization; tracing sampling rate kept low by default; alerts tuned conservatively and monitored for 72h.

Ethan: Please add unit tests that assert label normalization (no raw route names allowed). Also prefer stable metric names (v1->v2 migration note).
Sofia: Alert window of 10m seems fine but add target exemptions for low-traffic models to avoid flapping.
Infra-SRE (comment): ensure Prometheus scrape intervals won't explode cardinality for large clusters. Consider histogram bucketing adjustments.
author_replies: Arjun: 2.5x chosen empirically from a week's production baselines; we added linear-baseline helpers to help future automatic baseline derivation (see telemetry/helpers/baseline.rs).
Arjun: Added unit tests for label normalization and a migration note in docs. See tests/telemetry/test_metrics.rs commit.
Arjun: Added per-model dampening and allowlist for low-traffic models in token_alerts.yaml.
Arjun: Histogram buckets adjusted and we've added metric emission rate caps behind feature flag to protect scrape load.
